domain_controls.conditional_spectral_bound: For a positive Higgs background with h>=h0, both transverse and physical longitudinal Proca operators have spectrum bounded below by their vacuum mass squared. Sampled profile checks do not certify the hypotheses.
domain_controls.global_Goldstone_scope: Ungauged O(4) diagnostic. The three massless angular fields are not extra physical particles after electroweak gauging. Zero-energy continuum overlaps are not on-shell decay widths.
domain_controls.nonlinear_scope: Nonzero cubic GG and VV vertices remain. No off-shell VV*, loop photon, fermion or complete nonlinear decay calculation. Fixed gauge inputs are benchmarks, not experimentally matched couplings.
domain_controls.quadratic_radial_angular_gauge_mixing: Exactly zero on the real Higgs background; the separate Goldstone-longitudinal derivative block is retained.
